name: The Forecast of Last Tuesday
brief: The morning weather report adds a time forecast, scattered patches of last Tuesday over the Bronx clearing by noon, commuters walking through pockets of earlier weather, one block still raining a rain that already happened, umbrellas opening retroactively, eye flowers opening in the front line, color story: forecast map cyan and old rain silver over ink black.

name: The Aurora Over Broadway
brief: A temporal aurora unfurls the length of Broadway, ribbons of green and violet low enough to touch the theater marquees, every marquee's old shows flickering back into lights beneath it, the street tilting its head back as one, eye flowers opening along the aurora hem, color story: aurora green violet and marquee gold over ink black.

name: The Fog of Nineteen Seventy Seven
brief: A fog bank rolls in carrying nineteen seventy seven inside it, subway cars in the mist wearing their old paint, radios in windows tuning themselves back, the fog lifting at noon and returning everything gently ahead one block at a time, eye flowers opening in the mist, color story: fog nicotine amber and old paint spectrum over ink black.

name: The Snow That Fell Upward
brief: Over Central Park the snow falls upward at dusk, the meadow's blanket unknitting flake by flake into a rising white veil, sledders riding their hills in reverse with total joy, the park returning its winter to the sky on layaway, eye flowers opening in the rising flakes, color story: rising snow white and dusk meadow lavender over ink black.

name: The Heat Wave from August 1995
brief: A heat wave arrives verified as the exact August of nineteen ninety five, hydrants remembering their old arcs, stoops filling with the same card games, a whole borough granted one more evening of a summer everyone thought was finished, eye flowers opening in the heat shimmer, color story: heat shimmer gold and hydrant arc crystal over ink black.

name: The Lightning That Struck Twice Kindly
brief: The same bolt of lightning strikes the same Harlem antenna twice, forty years apart, the second strike delivering back everything the first one erased, a building's worth of taped albums and photographs raining down restored into waiting hands, eye flowers opening in the bolt's afterimage, color story: bolt white violet and restored photo sepia over ink black.

name: The Rainbow Interchange
brief: After a time storm a rainbow lands on the Kosciuszko interchange and stays for a week, traffic threading its arches, each lane passing through a different decade's light, commuters choosing their era by exit, eye flowers opening at the rainbow's roots, color story: rainbow spectrum and interchange concrete gray over ink black.

name: The Wind That Returned Hats
brief: A recurring wind runs the length of Fifth Avenue returning every hat it ever stole, fedoras and fitted caps and one wedding veil descending on their original owners or their descendants, an old man catching his father's homburg with both hands, eye flowers opening in the hat brims, color story: homburg charcoal and veil ivory over ink black.

name: The Micro Season of the Stoop
brief: One Bed Stuy stoop develops its own micro season, a two week golden autumn that visits in the middle of every month regardless of the calendar, neighbors scheduling porch coffees and proposals for stoop autumn, leaves falling from no tree in particular, eye flowers opening in the drifting leaves, color story: stoop autumn amber and brownstone rose over ink black.

name: The Thunder That Kept Time
brief: A slow thunderstorm parks over Queens and begins keeping time, one roll per hour on the hour, more reliable than any clock, the borough setting ovens and naps by it, its midnight twelve roll performed with obvious pride, eye flowers opening in the cloud base, color story: thundercloud slate and hour roll gold over ink black.

name: The Drizzle of Small Memories
brief: A light rain falls in which each drop carries someone's small lost memory, pedestrians pausing as a drop returns a phone number, a smell of a classroom, the name of a first dog, umbrellas left deliberately home all week, eye flowers opening in the puddle rings, color story: memory drop silver and puddle ring rainbow over ink black.

name: The Frost That Wrote Names
brief: The season's first frost writes on every windshield in Inwood the name of who each driver should call today, thawing unread by nine so the choice stays theirs, one man sitting in his car for ten minutes before dialing his brother, eye flowers opening in the frost ferns, color story: frost fern white and windshield dawn blue over ink black.

name: The Golden Hour Held Over
brief: Golden hour over the Manhattan skyline is held over by popular demand, the light staying at its exact best from five until midnight, photographers weeping openly on rooftops, the sun visible at the horizon patiently doing overtime, eye flowers opening in the long light, color story: held gold and skyline silhouette plum over ink black.

name: The Hail of Hard Candy
brief: A freak storm over Coney Island hails butterscotch and peppermints from a nineteen sixty three candy shop that closed owing the sky a debt, kids with upturned umbrellas harvesting, the boardwalk smelling like every grandmother's purse at once, eye flowers opening in the candy drifts, color story: butterscotch amber and peppermint red white over ink black.

name: The Weather Balloon Confessional
brief: A retired weather balloon drifts low over the boroughs collecting whispered worries through a trailing brass horn, carrying them up to altitude where they freeze harmless and fall later as ordinary snow, a queue forming on a Bronx roof at dusk, eye flowers opening on the balloon's skin, color story: balloon pearl and brass horn gold over ink black.

name: The Two Sunsets of September
brief: On the equinox the city receives two sunsets an hour apart, the first ordinary, the second replaying the best sunset of the past year by audience request, the streets grading westward into stillness twice, taxis pulling over without being asked, eye flowers opening in the double glow, color story: first sunset coral and encore sunset crimson gold over ink black.

name: The Puddle Portals of Mott Street
brief: After time rain the puddles on Mott Street reflect other decades instead of the sky, pedestrians stepping around a nineteen forties trolley visible in the shallow water, one kid jumping a puddle and landing with his sneakers briefly saddle shoes, eye flowers opening in the reflections, color story: puddle mirror sepia and neon sign jade over ink black.

name: The Blizzard That Sorted Itself
brief: A blizzard hits the five boroughs and politely sorts its snow, deep drifts on sledding hills, a light dusting on stoops, none at all on hospital ramps and bus stops, the plows idling confused while kids canonize the storm by name, eye flowers opening in the drift crests, color story: sorted snow white and plow idle amber over ink black.

name: The Humidity of Old Songs
brief: A humid front moves in carrying every song ever sung out a window in Spanish Harlem, the air thick with boleros at dusk, walking through it leaving melodies in your clothes for days, dry cleaners refusing to remove them, eye flowers opening in the thick gold air, color story: bolero gold and dusk brick terracotta over ink black.

name: The Forecast Battle
brief: Two rival weather androids on competing morning shows disagree so profoundly that each half of the city gets its forecasted weather, the border running down Broadway, umbrella vendors working one curb while sunglasses sell on the other, eye flowers opening along the meteorological divide, color story: rain side steel blue and sun side gold over ink black.

name: The Fog Horn Duet
brief: In deep time fog the harbor's horns are answered by a horn from nineteen twelve, the two ships conversing across a century of gray, tug crews standing silent at the rails listening to the old voice remember its route, eye flowers opening in the fog banks, color story: fog pearl gray and horn brass over ink black.

name: The Sun Shower Wedding
brief: A sun shower is booked for a Prospect Park wedding, rain and light together as the vows land, the couple ringed by guests holding no umbrellas because the rain has agreed to fall everywhere except the aisle, eye flowers opening in the lit rain, color story: sun shower gold silver and aisle grass emerald over ink black.

name: The Barometer of the Block
brief: An old brass barometer on a Bronx porch measures not pressure but the block's mood, its needle swinging to festive as a birthday assembles down the street, the abuela reading it each morning and cooking accordingly, eye flowers opening in the dial, color story: barometer brass and porch shade cool green over ink black.

name: The First Snow Archive
brief: The city archives one flake from every first snow since eighteen ninety eight in a crystal vault under Bryant Park, tonight the librarian adds this year's flake and lets a school group breathe on the glass of nineteen forty seven, eye flowers opening in the crystal lattice, color story: flake crystal and vault light ice blue over ink black.

name: The Clearing Wind
brief: After a week of heavy time weather a clean west wind crosses the city returning every hour to its right place, curtains lifting in every window at once, the whole skyline exhaling, laundry lines applauding on the rooftops, eye flowers opening in the freshened air, color story: clear wind white and rooftop line spectrum over ink black.

name: The Chrome Retriever
brief: A chrome robot retriever in a Kith style quilted dog coat plays fetch on the Sheep Meadow with a ball it throws for itself, timing each launch so it can sprint under and catch it, a crowd of real dogs studying the technique with respect, eye flowers opening in its polished flank, color story: chrome mirror and meadow green over ink black.

name: The Pigeon with the Gold Wing
brief: A pigeon with one prosthetic gold wing runs the Herald Square flock with gentle authority, the wing built by a watchmaker who owed the flock a favor, its turns leaving a brief gilded arc that tourists mistake for a trick of light, eye flowers opening in the wing joints, color story: prosthetic gold and pigeon slate over ink black.

name: The Bodega Dragon of Doyers Street
brief: A small brass dragon the length of a baguette lives in the rafters of a Doyers Street shop, descending nightly to count the register with the owner, breathing a pilot light flame that keeps the dumpling steamer perfect, eye flowers opening in its whisker curls, color story: brass dragon and steamer bamboo tan over ink black.

name: The Subway Silverfish School
brief: A school of chrome silverfish swims the subway tunnels between trains, flowing around commuters on platforms like mercury weather, considered good luck if they circle you and better luck if one pauses at your shoe, eye flowers opening in the school's turning, color story: silverfish mercury and tunnel signal green over ink black.

name: The Mechanical Hawk of the Bryant Lawn
brief: The library commissions a mechanical hawk to patrol Bryant Park, but it spends its days teaching sparrows aerodynamics instead, chalk diagrams on the reading room roof, its falconry glove perch retired to a museum case, eye flowers opening in its wing lattice, color story: hawk bronze and chalk diagram white over ink black.

name: The Koi of the Reflecting Pool
brief: Chrome koi surface in the museum reflecting pool wearing the reflections of whoever watches them, visitors leaning close to see themselves swim, one child staying until closing because his koi kept waving back, eye flowers opening in the pool rings, color story: koi mirror and pool tile celadon over ink black.

name: The Alley Cat with Nine Batteries
brief: A patchwork robot cat runs a Lower East Side alley on nine salvaged batteries, each from a different decade, its purr changing era depending on which cell is discharging, tonight purring in warm nineteen sixty four, eye flowers opening in its patch seams, color story: patchwork copper and alley lamp sodium over ink black.

name: The Carriage Horse Emeritus
brief: The park's first chrome carriage horse works only weddings and farewells now, its gait tuned to the exact rhythm that calms a nervous heart, pulling an empty carriage each dawn along its old route out of loyalty to the ghosts of fares, eye flowers opening in its mane cables, color story: horse chrome pearl and carriage lacquer black over ink black.

name: The Menagerie Freed the Zoo
brief: MONUMENT: on the coldest night the city's chrome animals converge on the Central Park Zoo and stand with the real animals through a heating failure, metal bodies warming penguin houses and snow leopard rocks with their reactor hearts until dawn, keepers arriving to find every species asleep against a shining guardian, eye flowers opening across the whole menagerie in one linked bloom, color story: reactor heart amber and zoo snow blue over ink black.

name: The Fire Escape Parrot Congress
brief: Escaped parrots and chrome mimic birds hold joint congress on a Bushwick fire escape, trading vocabularies, the machines learning Spanish curses while the parrots learn dial tones, their combined dawn chorus untranslatable and magnificent, eye flowers opening in the feather and foil, color story: parrot emerald and mimic foil silver over ink black.

name: The Turtle That Carried the Fountain
brief: A bronze turtle beneath a Village fountain is discovered to be load bearing and alive, carrying the basin on its back for a century without complaint, the city holding a ceremony to thank it and the turtle taking one commemorative step, its first, eye flowers opening in the fountain spray, color story: turtle bronze verdigris and fountain crystal over ink black.

name: The Rat Terrier of the Archive
brief: The municipal archive employs a clockwork terrier to hunt not rats but misfiled documents, its nose reading call numbers through steel drawers, tonight proudly retrieving a birth certificate lost since nineteen fifty one for a woman waiting upstairs, eye flowers opening in the file stacks, color story: terrier tin and file folder manila over ink black.

name: The Bee Automata of the Rooftop Meadow
brief: Jeweled mechanical bees supplement a Long Island City rooftop hive through late winter, waking the real colony gently in spring by demonstrating the first waggle dance of the season, honey that year carrying a faint taste of brass and considered the vintage, eye flowers opening among the hive frames, color story: bee jewel gold and hive frame amber over ink black.

name: The Seal of the East River Dock
brief: A chrome harbor seal hauls out on a Greenpoint dock each evening to watch the sunset with whoever shows up, polished by a decade of affectionate hands, holding the warmth of the day's sun well into dark for anyone who leans against it, eye flowers opening in its mirrored back, color story: seal mirror sunset and dock timber gray over ink black.

name: The Butterfly Router
brief: Iridescent machine butterflies carry the neighborhood's love notes between windows, landing on sills to deliver by opening their wings and projecting the message in light, tonight one carries a proposal four blocks and waits for the answer to carry back, eye flowers opening in the wing circuits, color story: wing iridescent and window light warm gold over ink black.

name: The Junkyard Rooster
brief: A rooster assembled from car horns and chrome bumpers crows the Willets Point yards awake each dawn, its call a chord of every horn it is made from, mechanics setting their watches by it and slipping it premium solder as feed, eye flowers opening in its bumper tail, color story: bumper chrome and dawn yard rust over ink black.

name: The Library Lions' Cubs
brief: The library lions are given two chrome cubs for the summer reading program, small enough for children to read aloud to, the cubs memorizing every story and purring the best sentences back at closing, eye flowers opening in their manes, color story: cub chrome and library step cream over ink black.

name: The Swan of the Boat Pond
brief: A silver swan glides the model boat pond letting toy sailboats draft in its wake, escorting becalmed vessels back to their child captains, its neck lowering in a bow to each skipper, an armada of tiny sails following it like a moon, eye flowers opening in its wake, color story: swan silver and toy sail spectrum over ink black.

name: The Watchdog Who Chose the Watchman
brief: A decommissioned security robot dog walks itself to the night watchman who was kindest to it and sits at his Staten Island door until adopted, its threat displays repurposed to warming slippers and announcing grandchildren, eye flowers opening in its alert lights gone soft, color story: alert light rose and porch wood honey over ink black.

name: The Carousel Menagerie Breakout
brief: On the season's last night the Bronx carousel's animals take a group stroll, ostrich and tiger and sea dragon walking the zoo fence to visit their living counterparts, returning to their poles by dawn with straw in their paint, eye flowers opening in the carousel lights, color story: carousel gilt and menagerie moonlight blue over ink black.

name: The Sparrow Cab Service
brief: Chrome sparrows run a livery service for insects during rush hour, ladybugs and bumblebees commuting in tiny cabs of folded wing, the dispatch perch on a Union Square lamppost handling the evening surge with two chirps and a whistle, eye flowers opening along the fare line, color story: sparrow chrome and ladybug lacquer red over ink black.

name: The Aquarium That Walked to the Sea
brief: A shuttered pet store's last aquarium grows chrome legs and walks its four goldfish to the Coney Island shore at sunrise, wading in to its rim and opening its glass door to the Atlantic, then standing empty in the surf like a proud parent, eye flowers opening in the released water, color story: goldfish orange and surf foam pearl over ink black.

name: The Peregrine Postmaster
brief: A chrome peregrine runs express delivery from the Verrazzano tower, two hundred mile an hour stoops delivering medicine coolers to rooftops across the harbor, its flight logged by lighthouse keepers as weather, eye flowers opening in its dive trail, color story: peregrine gunmetal and dive trail white over ink black.

name: The Menagerie Vet
brief: One Bronx veterinarian treats both kinds of animal, splinting a real pigeon's wing beside a chrome cat's servo, her waiting room a truce of species and materials, payment accepted in eggs, gratitude, and occasionally perfect solder, eye flowers opening in the clinic window plants, color story: clinic mint and solder silver over ink black.

name: The Last Firefly Relit
brief: When the season's last firefly dims in a McCarren hedge, the chrome fireflies arrive to relight it, lending charge wing to wing until it pulses once more over the softball field, the whole machine swarm dimming themselves so its light reads brightest, eye flowers opening in the hedge dark, color story: firefly ember and swarm glow soft gold over ink black.

name: The Platform for Other Decades
brief: Track sixty one beneath Grand Central reopens with departures boarding for other decades, a conductor in a Dior style tailored uniform punching tickets stamped with years, families embracing travelers bound for nineteen fifty two with return tickets pinned inside their coats, eye flowers opening along the platform edge, color story: departure board amber and uniform navy over ink black.

name: The Sleeper Car of Dreams
brief: The midnight train adds a sleeper car that travels through passengers' own best dreams, berths ticketed by need not fare, a night nurse riding one stop through a dream of the ocean and arriving at work restored, eye flowers opening in the berth curtains, color story: berth curtain wine and dream ocean teal over ink black.

name: The Conductor of Lost Time
brief: The midnight line's conductor collects lost time instead of fares, passengers paying with hours they wasted and receiving them back reinvested at the end of the line, tonight an insomniac cashing out three years of worry for one perfect sleeping dawn, eye flowers opening in the ticket punch confetti, color story: punch confetti gold and night window black over ink black.

name: The Freight of Forgiveness
brief: A midnight freight crosses the Hell Gate hauling sealed cars of the city's grudges to be released over open water, the bridge lighting rose as each car empties, harbor mist rising sweeter, the engineer keeping one small grudge as a souvenir, eye flowers opening along the trestle, color story: hell gate rose and freight car boxcar red over ink black.

name: The Last Car Speakeasy
brief: The last car of the two forty five is a rolling speakeasy from nineteen twenty eight, brass rails and a piano bolted to the floor, entered by knocking the old rhythm on the end door, tonight packed with off shift nurses learning the Charleston, eye flowers opening in the pressed tin ceiling, color story: speakeasy brass and gin fizz gold over ink black.

name: The Elevated Ghost Local
brief: The demolished Third Avenue el runs a ghost local at three in the morning, translucent cars gliding along an absent track past third floor windows, old timers waiting at phantom stations to ride one stop through their youth and walk home young for an hour, eye flowers opening in the ghost girders, color story: ghost steel pale blue and window lamplight amber over ink black.

name: The Departure Board Poet
brief: The station's split flap board composes poetry between trains, destinations flickering into couplets about leaving and returning, commuters lingering after boarding calls to read the stanza finish, the board saving its best line for the last train, eye flowers opening in the flipping tiles, color story: split flap black white and waiting room gold over ink black.

name: The Track Walker's Lantern
brief: A track walker's lantern passed down through four generations lights not just the rails but the right choice at every junction, tonight guiding a lost teenager who wandered into the tunnels safely to the one exit that opens onto his own block, eye flowers opening in the lantern glass, color story: lantern flame gold and tunnel dark violet over ink black.

name: The Border of the Boroughs of Sleep
brief: The midnight train crosses the border into the boroughs of sleep, stations named for dreams shared by enough New Yorkers to earn a stop, tonight calling at the flying dream, the endless apartment, and the one where the test is fine, eye flowers opening in the station tile mosaics, color story: sleep tile lavender and dream stop signage cream over ink black.

name: The Caboose Museum
brief: The line's retired caboose becomes a rolling museum of everything left on trains and never claimed, gloves and manuscripts and one wedding ring displayed with tickets home, riders occasionally recognizing their own losses and completing the exhibit by taking them back, eye flowers opening in the display cases, color story: caboose oxide red and case light warm over ink black.

name: The Rails Remembered the Steam
brief: One night a year the modern rails remember steam, every train crossing the Harlem River trailing a ghost plume and a whistle from eighteen ninety, bridge tenders saluting the century as it passes beneath their booth, eye flowers opening in the phantom smoke, color story: ghost steam white and river night indigo over ink black.

name: The Ticket Taken Back
brief: A con artist who sold fake tickets to other decades is sentenced to ride every trip he sold, honestly this time, returning from the last one having delivered forty apologies across forty years, his final act buying real tickets for everyone he wronged, eye flowers opening in the ticket stubs, color story: stub coral and gaslight era sepia over ink black.

name: The Night Gardener of the Right of Way
brief: Between the last train and the first, a gardener tends the wildflowers of the trackside right of way from a modified handcar, watering by lantern, her miles of secret meadow blooming for passengers who only ever see it as a blur of color and wonder briefly, eye flowers opening among her chicory, color story: chicory blue and handcar lantern amber over ink black.

name: The Farewell Platform Encore
brief: The station grants one platform farewell a night an encore, the train reversing thirty seconds so a goodbye can be done properly this time, tonight a father running the length of the platform for the hug he was too slow for, the whistle holding its breath, eye flowers opening in the steam, color story: encore steam pearl and platform clock green over ink black.

name: The Motorman's Museum of Dawns
brief: A retiring motorman donates his collection of four thousand dawns seen from the front window of the first Brighton train, projected nightly in the transit museum, visitors sitting in an old cab watching thirty years of sunrise over the same curve of Brooklyn, eye flowers opening in the projected light, color story: projected dawn rose and cab interior olive over ink black.

name: The Express to the Day Off
brief: A rumored express runs nonstop to a station called Your Day Off, appearing only to workers who have gone too long without one, tonight scooping up an entire double shift of hospital staff and delivering them to a platform that opens directly onto a beach that should not fit under Manhattan, eye flowers opening in the improbable sunlight, color story: impossible beach gold and scrubs teal over ink black.

name: The Signal Tower Chess Club
brief: The interlocking towers along the midnight line play a century long chess game using trains as pieces, tonight's move a graceful freight diverted through Fresh Pond, the towers flashing their lamps in appreciation of a particularly elegant knight, eye flowers opening in the signal lenses, color story: signal lens ruby emerald and tower lamp warm over ink black.

name: The Berth Above the City
brief: The midnight departure's observation car rises on elevated track high above the skyline for one span, berths tilting toward the glass as the whole city slides past below like a lit map, a new arrival pressing her palm to the window and choosing her neighborhood from altitude, eye flowers opening along the window frames, color story: lit map gold and observation glass night blue over ink black.

name: The Return Ticket Never Expires
brief: The line's oldest promise, every return ticket honored forever, is tested by a woman presenting her grandfather's unused nineteen thirty nine return from a journey he never got to finish, the conductor punching it without hesitation and walking her to the exact seat, eye flowers opening in the punched circle, color story: old ticket ochre and seat plush burgundy over ink black.

name: The Last Departure Waits
brief: The final midnight departure holds its doors for someone running late, and keeps holding, ten minutes, twenty, the whole train agreeing without a word that tonight the schedule serves the passenger, the runner arriving breathless to a car of quiet applause, eye flowers opening in the held doors, color story: held door light warm white and night platform slate over ink black.

name: The Morning It All Stayed
brief: The city wakes to find every visiting era decided to stay, hover lanes over cobblestones, time coupes parked between pushcarts, the timeline settling into one layered permanent now like sediment becoming stone, a paperboy delivering one paper with every date on it, eye flowers opening across all eras at once, color story: layered era sepia chrome and morning gold over ink black.

name: The Treaty of the Two Skylines
brief: The old skyline and the future skyline negotiate their merger on the harbor at dawn, art deco crowns and impossible glass spires arranging themselves into one silhouette both eras can love, tugboats bearing witness, the agreement sealed by the sunrise landing on both at once, eye flowers opening along the joined ridgeline, color story: deco bronze and future glass aurora over ink black.

name: The Everyone Reunion
brief: In the merged timeline every version of every New Yorker gets one afternoon together in Central Park, the meadow dense with selves comparing lives, forgiving choices, trading phone numbers across possibility, one woman picnicking with four of herself and finally at peace with all of them, eye flowers opening across the meadow, color story: picnic blanket spectrum and meadow warm green over ink black.

name: The Fashion of the Merged Age
brief: The first street style of the merged timeline debuts organically on one Delancey block, bar jacket couture over technical fleece, cashmere hover cloaks with bodega bag linings, tweed cut for jetpacks, photographers from every era agreeing they have never seen anyone look this much like themselves, eye flowers opening in every fit, color story: merged fashion spectrum and delancey dusk mauve over ink black.

name: The Machines' First Holiday
brief: The merged city declares the first official holiday for its machines, every awakened object and android and time coupe given the day off at once, humans covering their shifts with visible incompetence and total love, the machines spending the day in the parks doing absolutely nothing, magnificently, eye flowers opening in their rest, color story: holiday banner gold and park rest green over ink black.

name: The Bridge of All Hours
brief: The Brooklyn Bridge carries every hour it has ever carried simultaneously, promenade crowded with strollers from eighteen eighty three beside hover joggers, all crossing together, the cables humming a chord one hundred and forty years wide, eye flowers opening along every era's railing at once, color story: cable steel and all hours amber over ink black.

name: The Library of Unwritten Endings
brief: The library opens a wing for endings that almost happened, shelved futures browsable but checked out never, visitors reading the timelines where they left and understanding at last why they stayed, the librarian filing new almosts nightly with white gloves, eye flowers opening in the card catalog, color story: catalog oak and almost light pale silver over ink black.

name: The Hydrant's Long Summer
brief: In the merged timeline one Mott Haven hydrant is granted an infinite summer afternoon, its arc refusing every winter, the corner permanently four thirty in July, kids from every decade running through the same water, grandmothers from three eras sharing the same shade, eye flowers opening in the eternal spray, color story: spray crystal and july gold over ink black.

name: The Stoop at the Center
brief: Cartographers of the merged timeline locate its exact center, a modest Bed Stuy stoop where someone is always sitting, always willing to talk, the city rerouting itself gently around this fact, pilgrims arriving to sit for five minutes and leaving lighter, eye flowers opening in the stoop cracks, color story: stoop brownstone rose and center light soft gold over ink black.

name: The Orchestra of Everything
brief: On the great lawn the merged city's first orchestra seats humans, androids, awakened instruments, and one time coupe on percussion, playing a symphony composed by the skyline itself, the final movement scored for four million windows opening at once, eye flowers opening across the lawn, color story: orchestra black tie and window light constellation over ink black.

name: The Wardrobe Passed Forward
brief: The great houses of the merged age open their archives to the street, couture lent like library books, a Bronx teenager checking out a bar jacket for her scholarship interview and returning it with the luck sewn in for the next borrower, eye flowers opening in the lending tags, color story: archive ivory and lending tag mint over ink black.

name: The Night the Lights Agreed
brief: Every light in the merged city, gas lamp and neon and hover lane and window, agrees on one warm color for a single night, the skyline unified in candle gold, planes diverting for the view, astronauts reporting the city visible as one gentle ember, eye flowers opening in the unified glow, color story: agreement gold and night sky velvet over ink black.

name: The Rat King's Cashmere Court
brief: Squab holds the merged timeline's first full court beneath Delancey in a chamber upholstered by the quiet luxury androids, rats and machines and pigeons seated on cashmere benches as equals, the young king's bottle cap crown resting beside a new one woven from light he refuses to wear yet, eye flowers opening in the court vault, color story: court cashmere camel and light crown pale gold over ink black.

name: The Garden of Every Season
brief: The Brooklyn Botanic Garden blooms all four seasons at once in the merged age, cherry blossoms over autumn maples over snowdrops, visitors walking from June into October in ten steps, gardeners keeping the borders between seasons trimmed like hedges, eye flowers opening in every season simultaneously, color story: four season spectrum and border path slate over ink black.

name: The Diner Serves the Timeline
brief: The rocket diner hosts the merged timeline's first all era breakfast, egg creams beside future ambrosia, a nineteen twelve stevedore splitting a booth with a hover medic, the cook working six decades of orders from one griddle without dropping a beat, eye flowers opening in the menu board, color story: griddle gold and all era chrome over ink black.

name: The School of Both Histories
brief: The merged city's schools teach what happened and what almost happened side by side, students writing essays on the mercy of near misses, a Bronx classroom's window looking out on both the expressway that was built and the neighborhood that survived where it was not, eye flowers opening in the chalkboard, color story: chalkboard slate and near miss light silver over ink black.

name: The Harbor Full of Return
brief: Every ship that ever brought anyone to the city returns to the harbor for one dawn, steamships and ferries and one raft, ancestors at the rails waving to descendants on shore, the statue lifting her torch a fraction higher, eye flowers opening across the water like a fleet of their own, color story: fleet sepia and harbor dawn rose gold over ink black.

name: The Unemployment of the Alarm Clocks
brief: In the merged timeline the city's alarm clocks are made redundant by mornings people want to wake for, retraining en masse as timekeepers of naps and guardians of snooze, their union banner reading we ring only when wanted, eye flowers opening in their silenced bells, color story: banner red and snooze light lavender over ink black.

name: The Corner That Grants One Do Over
brief: One corner of the merged city grants each person a single do over, the line stretching years long and moving fast because most people, reaching the front, find they no longer need it and donate their turn, the corner glowing brighter with every donation, eye flowers opening in the donated light, color story: do over glow white gold and corner brick warm over ink black.

name: The Machines Wrote Back
brief: The awakened machines of every era publish one letter to the city, printed on every receipt and screen and split flap board at the same minute, thanking the people who were kind before kindness was required, the city reading at red lights and bus stops in a silence like snow, eye flowers opening in the printed words made light, color story: letter light warm white and city pause blue over ink black.

name: The Fitting of the Whole City
brief: The chrono atelier undertakes its final commission, a garment for the city itself, measuring the skyline with light threads at dusk, the finished piece revealed as nothing anyone can wear and everyone can feel, tailored belonging settling over five boroughs, eye flowers opening at every anchor point, color story: light thread gold and dusk fitting violet over ink black.

name: The Anthem in Every Key
brief: The merged city's anthem premieres as whatever song each listener loves most, all played at once from every window and somehow harmonizing, the composer credited only as the block, musicologists giving up analysis and dancing, eye flowers opening in the sound made visible, color story: anthem spectrum and window night amber over ink black.

name: The Last Skeptic Convinced
brief: The last New Yorker who refuses to believe any of it is finally convinced not by miracles but by his own stoop, which has quietly kept his coffee warm every morning for a year, his surrender delivered as a nod to the railing and a second cup left out in thanks, eye flowers opening in the coffee steam, color story: coffee warm brown and skeptic dawn gray gold over ink black.

name: The Museum of the Transition
brief: The city opens a museum of the years the future arrived, the first hover lane cone and the atelier's first light thread and one bodega coffee cup enshrined like relics, the final gallery just a window onto the living street with a label reading ongoing, eye flowers opening in the exhibit cases, color story: relic case glass and ongoing daylight over ink black.

name: The Keys to the City Duplicated
brief: The merged city mints eight million keys to itself and mails one to every resident, each key opening exactly one thing, the finding of which is the gift, a Queens plumber discovering his opens the observation deck at dawn before the crowds, eye flowers opening in the key teeth, color story: key brass and mailbox blue over ink black.

name: The Long Table Down Broadway
brief: Broadway closes end to end for one dinner at a single table thirteen miles long, every era and neighborhood seated in one unbroken line, dishes passed hand to hand from the Battery reaching Inwood still warm, the toast traveling up the island like a wave, eye flowers opening down the centerline, color story: table linen white and toast candle gold over ink black.

name: The Night Watch Handoff
brief: At four in the morning the old city formally hands the night watch to the merged one, lamplighters and androids and awakened streetlights meeting on the Williamsburg Bridge to pass a single small flame down the line, the handoff completed as the first ferry sounds, eye flowers opening along the watch line, color story: watch flame amber and bridge steel dawn blue over ink black.

name: The City Exhaled
brief: For one full minute the merged city exhales, every train pausing at a platform, every light resting warm, every machine and person and pigeon still, the harbor flat as glass, then the minute ends and everything resumes exactly as loud as before but somehow rested, eye flowers opening in the held stillness, color story: exhale silver and resume gold over ink black.

name: The First Morning of Forever
brief: CLOSER: the first ordinary morning of the merged timeline, no arrivals, no departures, just a Bronx kitchen where a time coupe idles outside like a family car, an android pours cereal for kids in school uniforms, a grandmother reads a paper dated simply today, sunlight crossing the table with nowhere better to be, eye flowers opening in the cereal steam and the window light, color story: kitchen morning gold and school uniform navy over ink black.

name: The Handoff at the Bodega Door
brief: CLOSER: at the bodega at the center of everything the owner flips the sign from open to open, the cat assumes the counter, a time coupe driver in cashmere holds the door for a kid in box fresh streetwear while an android debutante buys flowers that bloom twice, the whole merged city visible in one doorway, eye flowers opening across the threshold in a full arch, every light trail in New York converging gently on the awning, color story: awning red and converged gold over ink black.

name: The Facade Undressed at Dawn
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4367 The Facade Undressed at Dawn: HERO OPENER: on Greene Street at first light a cast iron facade unbolts itself and steps down from its building like a woman removing a gown, fluted Corinthian columns for limbs, leaving the naked brick blushing behind her, an old ironworker who bolted her up in nineteen seventy two waiting on the cobblestones with his hat off, the whole street of facades leaning out to watch, eye flowers opening in her column capitals, color story: iron verdigris green and dawn brick rose over ink black.

name: The Bolt Counter
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4368 The Bolt Counter: a stooped preservationist in a camel cashmere overcoat has spent forty years counting every bolt in the cast iron district, tonight the buildings finally count him back, thousands of bolt heads turning like eyes to follow his walk down Mercer, his notebook held to his chest like a psalter, eye flowers opening from the rivet seams, color story: bolt head gunmetal and notebook oxblood over ink black.

name: The Loft That Kept Painting
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4369 The Loft That Kept Painting: a SoHo loft where a painter died in nineteen eighty four keeps painting without her, brushes drifting at the tall windows, her last unfinished canvas growing an inch of new sky each year, tonight her granddaughter climbs the freight stairs with turpentine and stays to collaborate, eye flowers opening in the palette scrapings, color story: cadmium orange and loft window ultramarine over ink black.

name: The Corinthian Barber
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4370 The Corinthian Barber: a barber sets his chair on the sidewalk beneath a cast iron colonnade and trims the acanthus leaves of the column capitals like hair, scissors flashing, iron shavings curling to the cobbles in ringlets, the building sighing with pleasure, a queue of facades down the block waiting their turn, eye flowers opening among the trimmed acanthus, color story: barber chrome and acanthus iron green over ink black.

name: The Freight Elevator Confessions
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4371 The Freight Elevator Confessions: the hand cranked freight elevator of a Broome Street loft building rises only for the truth, tenants stating one honest thing at the gate before the drum turns, tonight a famous gallerist finally says the forgery aloud and rides up lighter than she has been in a decade, eye flowers opening between the oak slats, color story: elevator oak amber and gate iron black over ink black.

name: The Window Tax Ghosts
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4372 The Window Tax Ghosts: the bricked up windows of the old lofts open once a year onto the rooms as they were in eighteen ninety, sewing girls at gaslight visible through the phantom glass, a modern tenant in a boucle tweed suit pressing her palm flat against the wall to meet a palm pressing back, eye flowers opening in the phantom panes, color story: gaslight amber and brick shadow plum over ink black.

name: The Sidewalk Vault Lights
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4373 The Sidewalk Vault Lights: the purple glass discs set in SoHo sidewalks glow from below at midnight, the old vault spaces underneath lit and inhabited, pedestrians kneeling to peer down through the lenses at a ballroom of the district's first merchants dancing under the street, eye flowers opening in the violet glass, color story: vault glass violet and understreet gold over ink black.

name: The Iron Foundry Reunion
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4374 The Iron Foundry Reunion: every facade cast at the Cornell foundry returns one night to the East Village lot where the works once stood, forty building fronts standing in the empty yard like family at a grave, the last foundryman's great grandson walking the rows with a lantern touching each maker's mark, eye flowers opening at every touched mark, color story: foundry ember orange and night lot indigo over ink black.

name: The Cornice Diver
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4375 The Cornice Diver: a restoration climber in technical nylon and a battered varsity jacket works the crowning cornice of a Grand Street building without ropes because the building holds her, brackets curling gently around her boots as she leans out over five stories to regild the egg and dart moulding, eye flowers opening along the gilded run, color story: gold leaf and cornice shadow teal over ink black.

name: The Cast Iron Understudy
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4376 The Cast Iron Understudy: when a landmarked facade is trucked away for restoration, a young sheet metal apprentice stands in its place for three months holding the building's face, arms spread, learning what a hundred and fifty years of weather feels like, neighbors bringing him coffee and umbrellas, eye flowers opening across his outstretched arms, color story: apprentice denim blue and bare brick sienna over ink black.

name: The Fire Stair Aria
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4377 The Fire Stair Aria: an opera student practices on her Crosby Street fire escape and the cast iron district becomes her amphitheater, facades angling like cupped hands to carry the sound, the note held so long that rust flakes lift off the ironwork and hang in the air like gold dust, eye flowers opening in the suspended rust, color story: rust gold and aria night blue over ink black.

name: The Ghost Sign Painter
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4378 The Ghost Sign Painter: high on a brick party wall an old sign painter touches up the faded ghost advertisements at night, but paints them as pure fields of color and pattern, restoring the glow without the words, the wall becoming an abstract quilt of every product the block ever sold, eye flowers opening in the color fields, color story: ghost sign ochre and fresh coat crimson over ink black.

name: The Landmark Hearing
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4379 The Landmark Hearing: a demolition hearing where the building itself attends, the cast iron facade folding through the municipal doorway to sit quietly at the back of the room, and when the developer finishes speaking the whole chamber turns to look at her, columns straight, waiting, the stenographer weeping, eye flowers opening along her pilasters, color story: hearing room walnut and iron pale jade over ink black.

name: The Snow on Mercer
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4380 The Snow on Mercer: the first snow falls upward off Mercer Street's cobbles at blue hour, returning to a sky the color of wet slate, a fashion editor in a sculpted bar jacket coat standing perfectly still in the middle of the street letting the rising flakes undress the day from her, eye flowers opening in the rising snow, color story: rising snow white and blue hour slate over ink black.

name: The Bowery Ironclad
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4381 The Bowery Ironclad: a retired boxer walks the Bowery at dawn wearing the neighborhood's demolished buildings as armor, lost facades hanging from his shoulders like a coat of plate, each panel a building he trained in or slept in or bled in, moving slow under the weight and refusing to set it down, eye flowers opening between the armor plates, color story: armor iron gray and dawn sky salmon over ink black.

name: The Skylight Harvest
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4382 The Skylight Harvest: the sawtooth skylights of the old factories collect a century of trapped daylight, and one October evening a caretaker opens the valves, nineteen twenties sunshine pouring down the stairwells like honey, tenants wading through the golden flood carrying jars to save some for February, eye flowers opening in the poured light, color story: stored sun honey and stairwell teal over ink black.

name: The Cobble Cartographer
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4383 The Cobble Cartographer: a city surveyor discovers the Belgian block cobbles of Wooster Street rearrange themselves nightly into maps of the city's dreams, tonight kneeling with her brass instruments over a pattern that shows every apartment where someone is lying awake, planning to visit them all, eye flowers opening between the cobbles, color story: cobble slate blue and brass instrument gold over ink black.

name: The Awning Wings
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4384 The Awning Wings: the storefront awnings of a SoHo block unfurl at closing time into vast canvas wings, the buildings stretching after a long day of commerce, one shopgirl staying late to oil the mechanisms, riding an awning as it beats slowly like a resting gull, eye flowers opening along the canvas ribs, color story: awning canvas cream and mechanism oil bronze over ink black.

name: The Column Doctor
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4385 The Column Doctor: a structural engineer makes house calls with a leather bag and a stethoscope for the district's iron columns, listening to their hollow hearts, tonight diagnosing a Greene Street beauty with loneliness and prescribing the return of her original paint color, mixing it on the spot by lamplight, eye flowers opening in the paint tin, color story: original paint sage and doctor bag oxblood over ink black.

name: The Loading Dock Court
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4386 The Loading Dock Court: the raised loading docks of Crosby Street convene at midnight as a small parliament, longshoremen's ghosts and current couriers and one philosophical porter seated along the platforms debating whether the neighborhood still needs them, deciding annually and unanimously yes, eye flowers opening under the dock canopies, color story: dock timber umber and midnight vote gold over ink black.

name: The Iron Gardener
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4387 The Iron Gardener: an old woman tends the cast iron rosettes of her building like a garden, watering them at dusk from a copper can, and they bloom, iron petals unfolding with the groan of old hinges, the only iron garden in the city, tour guides forbidden to reveal the address, eye flowers opening among the iron roses, color story: iron rose black and copper can green over ink black.

name: The Palimpsest Tenant
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4388 The Palimpsest Tenant: a writer rents the loft where every previous tenant since eighteen seventy still faintly exists, sewing girls and sculptors and a disgraced senator layered in the air like tracing paper, all of them reading over her shoulder as she types, applauding silently at the good sentences, eye flowers opening through the layered figures, color story: palimpsest sepia and desk lamp gold over ink black.

name: The Rain That Polished
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4389 The Rain That Polished: a night rain falls on the cast iron district that polishes instead of rusts, every facade coming up like silver, the streets blinding with reflection, a doorman standing under his portico watching the whole district turn to mirror and seeing himself multiplied down five blocks, eye flowers opening in the mirrored iron, color story: polished silver and rain streak cyan over ink black.

name: The Demolition Wake
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4390 The Demolition Wake: the night before a corner building comes down the whole district sits up with it, neighbors filling its floors with candles and stories, the building letting itself be held, its cast iron face calm, and at dawn it lies down slowly by itself before the machines arrive, sparing everyone the sight, eye flowers opening in the candle field, color story: wake candle amber and iron mourning gray over ink black.

name: The Ghost of the Grid
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4391 The Ghost of the Grid: where the street grid breaks at the district's edge, the ghost of the surveyor who drew the plan in eighteen eleven walks the phantom line of a street that was never cut, passing through buildings politely, tipping his hat to tenants at their kitchen tables as he crosses their apartments, eye flowers opening along his chalk line, color story: chalk line white and surveyor coat bottle green over ink black.

name: The First Gargoyle Down
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4392 The First Gargoyle Down: at the stroke of two a terracotta gargoyle descends from a Gothic revival tower for the first time in ninety years, landing in the empty avenue with the weight of a dropped piano, cracking the asphalt, then straightening up shyly to ask a startled hot dog vendor which way to the river, eye flowers opening in the cracked asphalt, color story: terracotta rust and vendor umbrella yellow over ink black.

name: The Grotesque Union Meeting
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4393 The Grotesque Union Meeting: the city's grotesques hold their century meeting on the setbacks of a Financial District tower, chimeras and hunched scholars and winged dogs perched in parliamentary rows, voting with raised claws on whether to keep watching over a city that no longer looks up, the vote carrying by one wing, eye flowers opening along the setback ledges, color story: grotesque limestone gray and quorum moon silver over ink black.

name: The Downspout Oracle
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4394 The Downspout Oracle: a rain gargoyle on a Fifth Avenue church speaks only while water runs through her throat, so in every storm a line forms below, umbrellas tilted back, New Yorkers taking turns standing in the gush to hear one gargled sentence of advice each, all of it accurate, eye flowers opening in the falling water, color story: storm water pewter and umbrella spectrum over ink black.

name: The Gargoyle Who Loved a Cleaner
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4395 The Gargoyle Who Loved a Cleaner: for thirty years a facade grotesque has adored the night cleaner visible through the fortieth floor glass, and tonight the scaffold brings her to his ledge, the stone creature holding perfectly still as she wipes the grime from his face with the tenderness of the long acquainted, eye flowers opening between stone and glass, color story: office light warm white and stone cheek gray over ink black.

name: The Chrysler Eagle's Rounds
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4396 The Chrysler Eagle's Rounds: one of the steel eagles of the Chrysler Building makes its nightly circuit of midtown, chrome wings throwing moonlight into office windows to check on the late workers, escorting the last secretary to Grand Central by gliding low over her like a personal sky, eye flowers opening in the chrome feathers, color story: eagle chrome and midtown window amber over ink black.

name: The Gargoyle Physical Therapist
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4397 The Gargoyle Physical Therapist: a sports medicine doctor with a rooftop practice treats the city's grotesques for a century of crouching, stretching stone wings on a limestone parapet, prescribing posture exercises, her waiting ledge lined with patient chimeras holding their appointment pebbles, eye flowers opening in the stretched wings, color story: clinic towel white and limestone buff over ink black.

name: The Nightmare Eater
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4398 The Nightmare Eater: the oldest grotesque on the Upper West Side leaves his perch to crouch on the cornice outside children's windows, inhaling nightmares through stone nostrils as they rise off the sleeping like steam, growing heavier and calmer with each one, returning to his tower fat with other people's fear, eye flowers opening in the drawn steam, color story: nightmare violet smoke and nursery night lamp peach over ink black.

name: The Scaffold Romance
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4399 The Scaffold Romance: a restoration carver falls for the gargoyle she is recarving, her chisel finding a face in the weathered stone that turns toward her hand, the two of them working out across a summer which parts are memory and which are invention, the finished creature wearing one feature that is unmistakably hers, eye flowers opening in the stone dust, color story: stone dust pearl and chisel steel blue over ink black.

name: The Night the City Looked Up
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4400 The Night the City Looked Up: MONUMENT: every grotesque, eagle, atlas and angel on every facade in New York turns its head at the same instant toward a single point of light over the harbor, ten thousand stone faces rotating with a sound like a mountain clearing its throat, and every pedestrian on every avenue follows their gaze upward at once, the whole city caught mid look, eye flowers opening across a thousand ledges, color story: stone chorus gray and harbor light gold over ink black.

name: The Atlas Who Set It Down
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4401 The Atlas Who Set It Down: the bronze atlas who has carried his stone globe outside a Fifth Avenue tower since nineteen thirty seven finally sets it down on the sidewalk, rolls his shoulders, and sits on it like a park bench to watch the morning rush, commuters slowing to nod at him with the respect owed to anyone finishing a long shift, eye flowers opening around the resting globe, color story: bronze patina green and morning rush camel over ink black.

name: The Gutter Griffin Delivery
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4402 The Gutter Griffin Delivery: a small copper griffin from a Yorkville pediment runs a secret delivery service for the homesick, fetching one object from any childhood bedroom still standing, tonight bringing a nurse on her break the exact china dog from her grandmother's windowsill in Queens, eye flowers opening in its copper wings, color story: copper griffin teal and china dog white over ink black.

name: The Keystone Faces
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4403 The Keystone Faces: the carved faces in the keystones of a Riverside Drive block are the building's previous doormen, promoted into the architecture, and when the current doorman retires after fifty years the empty keystone above the entrance softens like clay, waiting for him, the whole block attending the ceremony, eye flowers opening around the soft stone, color story: keystone cream and doorman livery navy over ink black.

name: The Gargoyle Choir Practice
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4404 The Gargoyle Choir Practice: on nights of high wind the grotesques of Morningside Heights sing, wind through stone throats producing a chord that carries to the river, the cathedral's music director climbing to the parapets with a tuning fork and a thermos to rehearse them, correcting the tenor chimera gently, eye flowers opening in the wind mouths, color story: wind chord silver and cassock crimson over ink black.

name: The Weathervane Duel
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4405 The Weathervane Duel: two gilded weathervanes on facing towers have disagreed about the wind since eighteen ninety nine, and tonight they settle it, leaping their spires to circle each other over the avenue in a slow duel of gold silhouettes, the wind itself refusing to referee, both claiming victory at dawn, eye flowers opening in their gilded wake, color story: weathervane gold and duel sky storm blue over ink black.

name: The Spandrel Nap
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4406 The Spandrel Nap: an exhausted bike messenger discovers the deco spandrel panels of a Lexington tower fold out into berths, climbing into a sunburst of nickel bronze forty feet up for twenty perfect minutes, the building dimming its lobby lights below him and holding his bike in a bronze tendril, eye flowers opening in the sunburst rays, color story: nickel bronze and messenger bag safety orange over ink black.

name: The Frieze Marathon
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4407 The Frieze Marathon: the carved runners on a limestone athletic club frieze break free one November dawn and join the marathon at mile nineteen, stone athletes in low relief pacing the flesh ones up First Avenue, flattening back into any wall when they need rest, the crowd learning to cheer for the masonry, eye flowers opening along the frieze, color story: limestone runner buff and marathon bib coral over ink black.

name: The Lion Cub Lending
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4408 The Lion Cub Lending: the stone lions of the city's smaller institutions send their cubs to guard whoever needs it that week, a marble cub the size of a spaniel stationed outside a shift nurse's Inwood walk up, growling at bad news, walking her to the subway at four in the morning with its tail up, eye flowers opening in its marble mane, color story: marble cub white and walk up hallway green over ink black.

name: The Acroterion Bride
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4409 The Acroterion Bride: the winged victory on a Beaux Arts bank pediment steps down for one evening a year to walk the avenue in her limestone drapery, and tonight she stops at a bodega for flowers like anyone else, the clerk wrapping deli roses for a nine foot marble woman with the courtesy of a man who has seen everything, eye flowers opening in her stone garland, color story: marble drapery ivory and deli rose red over ink black.

name: The Pediment Court in Session
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4410 The Pediment Court in Session: the allegorical figures of Justice and Commerce and Industry climb down from a courthouse pediment at night to hear the small cases the day court missed, a stolen parking spot, a borrowed ladder never returned, rulings delivered from the courthouse steps with marble patience and enforced by reputation alone, eye flowers opening across the tympanum, color story: pediment marble and night docket lamp green over ink black.

name: The Gargoyle's Day Off
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4411 The Gargoyle's Day Off: once a century each grotesque receives one day of flesh, and today the hunched scholar from a Broadway tower spends his walking in the sun, eating a pistachio ice cream very slowly on the museum steps, feeling rain on skin at four, and reporting back to his ledge at midnight that it was worth the wait, eye flowers opening in his softened shadow, color story: pistachio green and flesh day gold over ink black.

name: The Terracotta Physician
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4412 The Terracotta Physician: a facade conservator known to every ornamented building in the city works from a van full of clay and gold size, and tonight three towers have quietly rearranged their scaffolding to be next, competing for her hands, leaving small offerings of perfect terracotta fragments on the van's hood, eye flowers opening in the clay slip, color story: terracotta blush and conservator apron slate over ink black.

name: The Balustrade Ballet
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4413 The Balustrade Ballet: the urn shaped balusters of a Riverside mansion roofline detach at three in the morning to dance a slow round on the parapet, stone urns pirouetting against the river sky, the insomniac who watches from across the street every night finally invited up by a lowered ladder of ivy, eye flowers opening among the dancing urns, color story: baluster ivory and river night navy over ink black.

name: The Grotesque Apprentice Exam
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4414 The Grotesque Apprentice Exam: a young stone carver's final examination is judged not by masters but by the gargoyles themselves, her carved creature placed on a ledge overnight among them, and at dawn the verdict, the old grotesques have shifted closer around it, one resting a claw on its shoulder, the guild's highest possible mark, eye flowers opening around the new creature, color story: fresh cut stone pale and elder grotesque charcoal over ink black.

name: The Waterspout Baptism
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4415 The Waterspout Baptism: during a summer cloudburst the rain gargoyles of an uptown church aim their spouts inward for once, filling the forecourt into a shallow silver pool, and the block arrives barefoot, kids and elders wading under the arcs of falling water in an unplanned festival the pastor declines to end, eye flowers opening in the pooled rain, color story: pool silver and cloudburst charcoal over ink black.

name: The Last Watch of the Woolworth Owls
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4416 The Last Watch of the Woolworth Owls: the carved owls of the old towers gather on one Gothic crown to keep the final watch of the night shift, huge stone birds shoulder to shoulder against the pre dawn, and as the sun breaks they turn their heads in unison one last quarter turn and lock, handing the city to the day, eye flowers opening in their stone irises, color story: owl stone taupe and first light rose gold over ink black.

name: The Elevator Empress
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4417 The Elevator Empress: the last human elevator operator in a nickel bronze deco tower runs her car like a court, white gloves on the lever, regulars bowing slightly as they enter, and the building loves her so completely that her car alone still smells of nineteen thirty one, gardenia and machine oil, eye flowers opening in the inlaid marquetry, color story: marquetry rosewood and glove white over ink black.

name: The Sunburst Door Keeper
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4418 The Sunburst Door Keeper: the nickel sunburst doors of a Wall Street tower open only for those entering with honest intentions, sticking politely for everyone else, and the doorman has built a forty year career on reading the doors, tonight watching them swing wide for a nervous kid in box fresh sneakers here for his first interview, eye flowers opening in the sunburst rays, color story: nickel ray silver and interview suit navy over ink black.

name: The Setback Gardens
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4419 The Setback Gardens: the ziggurat setbacks of a nineteen thirty tower terrace into hanging gardens after dark, deco balustrades sprouting moonflowers, and the tower's oldest tenant, a retired chorus girl of ninety six, waters them nightly in a silk robe, dancing a little on the parapet because no one is watching and everyone is, eye flowers opening among the moonflowers, color story: moonflower white and silk robe jade over ink black.

name: The Lobby Muralist Returns
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4420 The Lobby Muralist Returns: the WPA muralist who painted a deco lobby's ceiling in nineteen thirty four returns as a young man every leap night to add one figure, the ceiling now crowded with ninety years of the building's own tenants rendered in fresco, tonight painting in the new super, who stands below holding the ladder for a ghost, eye flowers opening across the fresco sky, color story: fresco cerulean and scaffold pine over ink black.

name: The Mailchute Correspondence
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4421 The Mailchute Correspondence: the brass mail chute of a midtown tower delivers letters between decades, a nineteen forties stenographer on twelve and a modern actuary on thirty writing daily down the same glass throat, their letters passing mid chute with a spark, tonight arranging at last to meet in the lobby at a time that exists for neither, eye flowers opening along the chute glass, color story: brass chute gold and letter paper ivory over ink black.

name: The Radiator City Symphony
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4422 The Radiator City Symphony: on the first cold night the deco towers' radiators knock in deliberate rhythm, building to building across midtown, a percussion symphony in steam, and one insomniac composer on a high floor transcribes it furiously, finally understanding what the city has been performing every winter of her life, eye flowers opening in the steam clefs, color story: radiator iron black and steam pearl over ink black.

name: The Terrazzo Constellations
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4423 The Terrazzo Constellations: the gold flecks in a deco lobby's terrazzo floor are stars, and after midnight the floor becomes transparent night sky, the porter mopping across the cosmos in slow arcs, planets drifting under his bucket, tenants coming down in robes just to lie on the constellation of their own birthdays, eye flowers opening among the terrazzo stars, color story: terrazzo night blue and gold fleck over ink black.

name: The Penthouse That Refused the View
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4424 The Penthouse That Refused the View: a deco penthouse turns its windows away from the skyline and toward its owner's better memories, the casements showing her mother's kitchen in nineteen sixty eight, a beach in August, a hallway where someone once waited with flowers, real estate agents baffled, the owner serene, eye flowers opening in the casement frames, color story: memory window amber and penthouse plaster cream over ink black.

name: The Spire Lamplighter
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4425 The Spire Lamplighter: the crown lights of the deco towers are lit each dusk by a lamplighter who climbs the mooring masts with a brass taper, a job the buildings insist on though the switches work fine, because fire remembered by hand burns warmer, his silhouette against the crown a nightly midtown blessing, eye flowers opening in the crown glow, color story: crown light champagne and dusk sky violet over ink black.

name: The Cigarette Girl's Century
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4426 The Cigarette Girl's Century: the ghost of a nineteen thirties cigarette girl works the lobby of her old tower selling small necessities from her tray, reading glasses, subway fare, one true compliment, accepting payment only in gossip, the doormen keeping her tray stocked for ninety years out of respect and superstition, eye flowers opening around her pillbox hat, color story: tray lacquer red and lobby bronze over ink black.

name: The Zigzag Staircase Race
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4427 The Zigzag Staircase Race: once a year the towers race their own staircases, buildings folding their zigzag fire stairs into legs and sprinting the length of Park Avenue at four in the morning, foundations and all, returning to their lots before dawn slightly out of alignment, which surveyors have documented and declined to explain, eye flowers opening in the stair rhythm, color story: stair steel graphite and race dawn coral over ink black.

name: The Frozen Fountain Doors
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4428 The Frozen Fountain Doors: the frozen fountain motif on a deco theater's bronze doors thaws on opening nights, metal water resuming its leap, spraying real drops on the queue, and the coat check girl collects the bronze water in a champagne bucket, selling drops as luck to nervous performers, eye flowers opening in the bronze spray, color story: bronze water gold and theater carpet crimson over ink black.

name: The Eyebrow Window Watch
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4429 The Eyebrow Window Watch: the curved eyebrow windows of a Central Park West tower are the building's actual eyes, and the night porter has learned to read its moods, tonight the eyebrows arched with worry over one darkened apartment, so he rides up with soup and knocks, correct as always, the building sighing its relief through the elevator shaft, eye flowers opening in the window curves, color story: eyebrow glass smoke and soup pot copper over ink black.

name: The Speakeasy Behind the Frieze
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4430 The Speakeasy Behind the Frieze: a chevron frieze in a deco lobby slides open for those who knock the right syncopation, revealing the speakeasy sealed in nineteen thirty three, the band mid number for ninety years, and tonight a young trumpet player from the building finds the rhythm by accident and is pulled in to sit in, emerging at dawn ninety years better, eye flowers opening in the chevron gap, color story: speakeasy brass and chevron malachite over ink black.

name: The Manicurist of the Fortieth Floor
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4431 The Manicurist of the Fortieth Floor: a manicurist keeps a one chair salon in a deco tower's abandoned observation gallery, her clients the city's most tired hands, surgeons and seamstresses and one retired safecracker, each session ending with the chair rotated to the glass so the hands can rest on the railing and hold the whole skyline for a minute, eye flowers opening at the gallery rail, color story: lacquer coral and observation glass dusk blue over ink black.

name: The Incinerator Phoenix
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4432 The Incinerator Phoenix: the sealed incinerator of a nineteen twenty nine tower hatches a phoenix of ash and ember that lives in the chute system, riding between floors, warming cold apartments through the walls, fed by the super on the anniversary of every fire the building survived, its feathers the gray of old smoke shot with live orange, eye flowers opening in its ash plumage, color story: ember orange and ash feather gray over ink black.

name: The Weekend of the Awnings
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4433 The Weekend of the Awnings: one weekend a summer the deco towers put out their original striped canvas awnings, every window suddenly wearing nineteen thirty six, and the avenue below fills with tenants who dress to match without planning it, bias cut dresses and high waisted trousers surfacing from closets, the decade returning by wardrobe consensus, eye flowers opening in the awning stripes, color story: awning stripe forest and bias cut champagne over ink black.

name: The Tower Clock's Apprentice
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4434 The Tower Clock's Apprentice: the great four faced clock of a deco tower takes a human apprentice each generation, and tonight a horologist's daughter climbs into the movement to learn the city's true time, which runs fast near weddings and slow near hospitals, her first duty to hold the minute hand back twelve seconds for a proposal on the plaza below, eye flowers opening among the gears, color story: clock brass and movement shadow indigo over ink black.

name: The Marble Switchboard
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4435 The Marble Switchboard: in a tower basement the original switchboard still connects calls between any two tenants who ever lived there, and the night operator, third of her family in the seat, tonight patches a widower on nine through to nineteen fifty eight, letting him hear his late wife answer their old extension one more time, timing the disconnect with mercy, eye flowers opening in the cord jungle, color story: switchboard cord scarlet and marble panel gray over ink black.

name: The Rooftop Mooring
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4436 The Rooftop Mooring: the dirigible mooring mast that never received an airship finally gets its arrival, a ghost zeppelin of nineteen thirty one docking silently at three in the morning, passengers in traveling clothes descending the spire stairs into the modern lobby, checking coats that dissolve by dawn, the night staff serving them with perfect period courtesy, eye flowers opening along the mooring spire, color story: zeppelin silver and arrival lamp warm gold over ink black.

name: The Elevator Music Composer
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4437 The Elevator Music Composer: a disgraced concert pianist takes the job composing live music for a single deco elevator, a hidden console in the shaft, scoring each ride to its passengers, funeral suits get Chopin, first dates get Gershwin, and the building fills its cars all day with people riding to nowhere just to be understood for eleven floors, eye flowers opening in the shaft acoustics, color story: piano black and shaft light honey over ink black.

name: The Chrome Hood Ornament Herd
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4438 The Chrome Hood Ornament Herd: the hood ornaments of the nineteen thirties, leaping gazelles and winged women and silver greyhounds, run as a chrome herd up Park Avenue at four in the morning, migrating between the towers where their cars once parked, a night doorman leaving a salt lick of polished nickel on the curb, eye flowers opening in the chrome flanks, color story: chrome herd silver and avenue night blue over ink black.

name: The Powder Room Portrait
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4439 The Powder Room Portrait: the etched mirror of a deco theater powder room retains every face that ever checked itself there, and tonight it composes them into counsel for a bride hiding from her own reception, a jury of ninety years of nervous women assembling in the glass to tell her, with one voice, exactly what she already knows, eye flowers opening in the mirror etching, color story: mirror mercury and bridal satin blush over ink black.

name: The Steam Whistle Nocturne
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4440 The Steam Whistle Nocturne: the last steam whistle on a deco power station plays one long note at two in the morning each New Year, a note that reaches every borough, and the engineer who inherited the pull chain from her father stands in the whistle house with her whole family in coats, all hands on the chain together, the city pausing mid celebration to hear its oldest voice, eye flowers opening in the steam column, color story: whistle steam white and power station brick oxblood over ink black.

name: The Court in Full Session
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4441 The Court in Full Session: on the equinox the deco towers of midtown incline their crowns toward each other over the avenues, a court of jeweled kings in conference, spire lights conferring in slow morse, and the pedestrians below walk the canyon floor under the leaning monarchs without alarm, this being, after all, New York, eye flowers opening in the crown jewels, color story: crown jewel spectrum and canyon shadow charcoal over ink black.

name: The Stoop Sitter General
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4442 The Stoop Sitter General: the eldest stoop sitter of a Bed Stuy block commands her brownstone steps like a flagship, folding chair for a throne, and the block's carved stone brackets and cornices lean subtly toward her when she speaks, the architecture itself among her constituents, tonight settling a dispute between two buildings about a shared drainpipe, eye flowers opening in the stoop ironwork, color story: stoop brownstone rose and folding chair plaid over ink black.

name: The Parlor Floor Time Capsule
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4443 The Parlor Floor Time Capsule: behind the shutters of a parlor floor the original eighteen eighty five interior persists in full, gasolier lit, and the house admits one visitor a year through the pocket doors, tonight choosing the plumber who has been kind to its pipes for twenty years, sitting him down to a laid table under plaster medallions to be thanked properly, eye flowers opening in the ceiling medallion, color story: gasolier amber and pocket door walnut over ink black.

name: The Bay Window Aquarium
brief: NEW YORKERS by MLow, character 4444 The Bay Window Aquarium: a brownstone's curved bay window fills with slow ocean at dusk, kelp and lanternfish drifting between the curtains, the family eating dinner in green aquarium light without comment, and passersby gathering nightly on the sidewalk to watch the room's octopus rearrange the framed photographs on the mantel, eye flowers opening among the kelp, color story: aquarium green and mantel photo sepia over ink black.

name: The Cornice Baker
